changelog:
Auto Repair & Auto Body Shop Marketing Kit — Initial Release

- Launches a comprehensive marketing content generator for auto repair, service, and collision shops with strict legal and compliance safeguards.
- Provides four core prompt templates: Seasonal Campaigns (free), Website Copy & Compliance Review, Review/Reputation/Referral System, and Digital Ads/Local SEO/Fleet Outreach (paid).
- Enforces exact ASE, EPA, FTC warranty, and state estimate law language for all outputs—protecting users from regulatory risk and leveraging compliance as a trust builder.
- Generates ready-to-use campaigns, ads, website copy, SEO schema, reputation responses, and fleet outreach materials, all tailored to specific shop credentials and local/state requirements.
- Includes over 20 content outputs per prompt, with messaging adapted to various platforms (Google, Facebook, SMS, Nextdoor, email, ads).
